summary: Receives point-cloud data from an OAK Device CHOP stream. It references the OAK Device CHOP, selects a stream, and manages a small cache for asynchronous buffer updates.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Retrieve data from the OAK Device CHOP when enabled

key_params.name: chop
key_params.note: OAK Device CHOP running the depthai pipeline

key_concepts: OAK Select POP receives point-cloud data from an OAK Device CHOP stream.
The operator is a selector/receiver, not a source by itself: it needs an OAK Device CHOP running a depthai pipeline and a valid stream name.
Active controls whether data is retrieved from the referenced OAK Device CHOP.
Cache Size behaves like the OAK Select CHOP queue-size control; the official docs call out 2 as a useful default for displaying one buffer while writing another.
Because the output depends on hardware and device-pipeline streams, planner-generated networks should guard availability before assuming it can cook.
common_gotchas: Requires a configured OAK Device CHOP and valid stream; it is not a standalone point generator.
Cache Size 2 is the documented practical default for display plus asynchronous writing.
Device-dependent operators need availability checks before generated networks assume they can cook.
